text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Seeking the Pearl, we were stopped by an 
energetic voice.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, little ladies, how about some 
miso soup tonight? I just got in some 
prized miso that impressed a hundred 
chefs!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Such a rich aroma...! This is undeniably 
of the finest taste!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: However—I am sorry! I will pass for today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl would normally leap at 
the chance to seek out new miso soup 
possibilities. She seems a little off 
today.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"There's something else I want. Would you 
mind accompanying me on a shopping trip?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Umm, first daikon radish and Chinese 
cabbage... Maybe I'll buy some fried tofu 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For the broth... let's use both bonito and 
kelp! Oh, and we can't forget the star of 
the show, the miso!
choice_data_list: Huh, don't you need the miso?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The one I wanted was a different miso.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Seeking the Pearl picked up was 
neither high-end nor fancy—just ordinary, 
everyday household miso.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Alright, that's everything gathered.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer. Here, dig in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is standing stiff and 
formal. Evidently, she has extraordinary 
feelings about this miso soup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, there are no standout traits 
to the flavor; it tastes like ordinary 
home-cooked miso soup. It is... strangely 
normal."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. You have that "Why?" look on your 
face.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...I've got it! The answer is food 
pairing! There was no need to force them 
together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Stopping opened up such a whole new world! 
It's all thanks to you stopping me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today's miso soup declaration of intent, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"—I poured my feelings into this, wishing 
to carve out a future as warm and rich as 
this miso soup together with you."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"This plain miso soup is the future 
itself. A blank canvas, brimming with 
endless possibilities."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Make it tastier? Increase its nutritional 
value? There are plenty of other things we 
can do.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What steps should we take? What utensils 
should we use? Nothing is set in stone, 
which means we can decide whatever we 
want!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't the future the same way? All kinds 
of choices are spread out right in front 
of you!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to carve open a future full of such 
possibilities together with you from now 
on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With you, we can achieve great feats that 
will turn the whole world upside down!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With you, we can etch our names into 
racing history and create a legend that 
will be told for all eternity!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With you, who opened my eyes to the new 
possibilities of miso soup, I feel like I 
can accomplish anything!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I feel like the two of you can do 
it!
Yeah, I feel like you two can do it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Trainer. Tell me. What kind of 
future do you envision right now?”
choice_data_list:
It's a future where we keep on challenging 
ourselves!

I just wish we could keep smiling like 
this forever...

The only thing I know for sure... is that 
you're by my side, I guess.

The only thing I know for sure is that 
you're right by my side... I guess.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Trainer. Tell me. What kind of 
future do you envision right now?”
choice_data_list:
It's a future where we keep on challenging 
ourselves!

I just wish we could keep smiling like 
this forever...

The only thing I know for sure... is that 
you're by my side, I guess.

The only thing I know for sure is that 
you're right by my side... I guess.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. We have no need for a finish 
line.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even beyond reaching your goals and 
fulfilling your dreams, possibilities 
continue to expand!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "We can't just stand by and watch that!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Let us push forward to the ends of the 
earth! Together, you and I!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A future of constant challenges won't be 
smooth sailing. But as long as we're 
together, we can overcome any path. Of 
that, I was absolutely certain!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho! What a lively and wonderful 
future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Laughter is full of energy! It has the 
power to draw out possibilities!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us keep laughing together! Let 
our laughter echo across the world, and 
seize every single possibility in our 
hands!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohohoho!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sounds of their laughter echoed far 
and wide. The day their voices take the 
world by storm will surely come!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So good! I feel the exact same way!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we try predicting what 
might happen between those two?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For instance... how about taking 1st place 
in an unprecedented 100-runner world race?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"You and I are going to become a 
monumental legacy! It's the beginning of 
history!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The future of the two grew increasingly 
vibrant, and the ideas never ceased to 
flow. And so, they continued chatting 
until the sun went down!
